svg.title: Share who stopped the drug because of side effects, by drug, on each US label
svg.desc: Permanently stopped treatment because of adverse reactions in the weight-management trials, drug vs placebo: Foundayo 17.2 mg 10% vs 3%; Wegovy pill 25 mg 6.9% vs 5.9%; Wegovy shot 2.4 mg 6.8% vs 3.2%; Zepbound 15 mg 6.7% vs 3.4%. Sources: Foundayo, Wegovy and Zepbound prescribing information, section 6.1.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
